description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ForbiddenException' within the OrangeHRM project. It extends the built-in PHP Exception class and implements a specific interface for validation exceptions, indicating it is used for handling unauthorized access errors in the API.

classes.name: ForbiddenException
classes.description: A custom exception class used to represent 'Forbidden' or unauthorized access errors within the OrangeHRM API. It provides a default message and can be constructed with custom messages or previous exceptions.
